entities.name: Taivas
entities.description: The human founder of the town of Traublassen on Innistrad, who bound the entity Umbris to the town.

entities.name: Traublassen
entities.description: A town on Innistrad founded by Taivas.

entities.name: Umbris
entities.description: A malevolent entity bound to Traublassen by Taivas's spellwork, feeding on the townspeople's fears and sorrows.

entities.name: Vytas
entities.description: The owner of the manor that holds a portrait of Taivas.

events.summary: Taivas founds Traublassen and builds it from nothing.
events.quote: Taivas was the human founder of the town of Traublassen

events.summary: Taivas devises a pact with the entity Umbris, binding it to the town by spellwork to keep the townspeople in check.
events.quote: he devised a sinister pact with a malevolent entity known as Umbris

relations.quote: Taivas was the human founder of the town of Traublassen

relations.note: He bound it to the town by spellwork.
relations.quote: This entity, bound to the town by Taivas’s spellwork, fed on the fears and sorrows of the town's people.
